title: Quantifying Availability and Discovery in Recommender Systems via Stochastic Reachability
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes an evaluation procedure to quantify the availability of content and users' discovery opportunities in recommender systems.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its findings focus on the impact of recommender system design choices (preference models, selection rules) on content availability and user discovery, highlighting issues like popularity bias.
